review_evidence: The source contains the divided-power algebra, divided-power structures, graded constructions, tensor products, topology, homogeneous algebra, and substantial ForMathlib material.
DividedPowers/Test.lean and PolynomialLaw/Test.lean contain actual lemmas/examples, including three combinatorial theorems in Test.lean; test naming is therefore not an exclusion signal.

The Oneshot tree contains hundreds of definitions/theorems across divided powers, infinite sums, power series, graded algebra, and tensor products. Oneshot/Main.lean is import-only navigation into retained modules and is kept rather than hard-excluded.
summary: Reviewed the complete DividedPowers4 repository; current and Oneshot divided-power developments, tests, and navigation files remain searchable with no additional hard exclusion.
